تقتتلي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَتِلِي (taqtatilī) /taq.ta.ti.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# تُقْتَتَلِي (tuqtatalī) /tuq.ta.ta.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
